[[Razakel]] is the [[Demon]] form of [[Terick]]. He refers to Terick as a "vessel" and claims that he used [[Vizier Khilbron]] to wipe [[Orr]] from the world.

== Notes ==
* Razakel was one of the demons that helped [[Abaddon]] cause [[the Cataclysm]].
* Razakel is also a common name used for a demon in many games and stories.
